metaTitle: Custom Two Tone Lanyards Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom two tone lanyards badges for your team. Durable polyester with your logo. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Two tone lanyards badges combine two contrasting colors to create a professional, branded look that stands out at events, trade shows, or daily office use. The dual-color design allows you to match your company colors or add a subtle accent to a neutral base. Made from durable double ply polyester, these lanyards resist fraying and hold up to daily wear. Common decoration methods include screen printing or full-color dye sublimation for crisp logos on both color panels.
heroAltText: Custom two tone lanyards badges with contrasting colors and a bulldog clip attachment for ID cards
